newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gruma launches new share offer.
newsitem.headline: Gruma launches new share offer.

text.p: Mexican holding company Gruma S.A. launched a primary and secondary share offer on Thursday totalling 5.6 percent of share capital, the company said in information released by the Mexican Stock Exchange (Bolsa).
Gruma, holding company for tortilla-maker Maseca, said shares will be sold for 37 pesos each and that the offer will end on Friday.
The offer is divided the following way:
Four local shares will make up one American Depository Share to be offered in U.S., Canadian, European and Asian markets, the company said.
It said the amount of shares on offer could be extended by an additional 15 percent in the event of oversubscription.
If the issue is oversubscribed, the total share offer would equal 6.4 percent of share capital.
Morgan Stanley will act as lead manager for the deal in foreign markets, while local brokerage firms Banorte and Accival will act as local lead managers, the company said.
